Thanks for taking the slot and running the session — quick debrief notes and next steps: please paste short bullets into the shared debrief doc (linked) by EOD Monday. If any of you want to escalate to a follow-up system-design interview, flag it there.

Quick notes from my side (based on transcript + Kim's live notes):
- Correctness: Eli completed the core algorithm and passed the basic property tests (edge cases for attention masks handled).
- Code style: readable and incremental; could be tighter on function extraction.
- System/design: good intuition on KV-cache tradeoffs; suggested a sharded KV approach but did not quantify cross-shard comms.
- Recommendation: move to a focused system-design follow-up for 45m to probe scaling tradeoffs before final decision.
